findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

On arrival the sanitizer in the knife bucket attached to the prep counters was observed to have a concentration of approximately 10 ppm CL on both the inspector’s and facility’s test strips. The effective minimum concentration for CL based sanitizers is 50 ppm. The PIC was shown and changed the bucket to correct. Ensure that all sanitizers are maintained at effective levels at all times.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.110 Using Dressing Rooms and Lockers. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of EMPLOYEE clothing and other possessions. 

1) On arrival a phone was observed on the prep counter in the back of the kitchen. 2) The cord of a phone charger is observed hanging down and laying on the prep counter in the back. The PIC was told about both items and instructed to ensure that employee items are stored away from preparation and food contact areas. The items were removed during this inspection to correct.
